mapping.summary: Tracks and allocates freight costs, matches carrier invoices
claims: Creates transport costs from sales orders, quotes, purchase orders and warehouse documents
Transport cost lifecycle stages Planned, Estimated, Confirmed, Allocated
Guided wizard to match shipping agent purchase invoices to transport costs, including bulk invoices
Allocates transport costs by weight, quantity or manually via item charge assignments
Shipping agent price catalog with net and gross prices on shipping agent services
Compares estimated vs actual freight cost with variance amount and percentage
Separates transport margin from product margin
Transport cost FactBox on sales orders, quotes, purchase orders and posted sales invoices
